  {
    "id": "Req-5/3",
    "section": "5",
    "section_title": "Maintain Patients Profile",
    "text": "A Patient cannot be deleted if there is one or more Consultation Requests in last 3 years",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-6",
    "section": "6",
    "section_title": "Consultation Request",
    "text": "Registered Patients shall have the ability to raise Consultation Requests",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-6",
    "section": "6",
    "section_title": "Consultation Request",
    "text": "2 Modes would be available - Appointment and Offline Consultation",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-6/1",
    "section": "6",
    "section_title": "Consultation Request",
    "text": "Patient creates a Consultation Request by entering the Symptoms, uploads reports, if any and defines the mode of request (Offline/Appointment)",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-6/2",
    "section": "6",
    "section_title": "Consultation Request",
    "text": "For Appointment Requests, an entry shall be created in the Patient Appointment File if the appointment is for next day",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-6/3",
    "section": "6",
    "section_title": "Consultation Request",
    "text": "This is batch program that will be run by Administration every night to create Appointment File for next 5 days",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-6/3",
    "section": "6",
    "section_title": "Consultation Request",
    "text": "It will purge the existing files",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-7",
    "section": "7",
    "section_title": "Predict Disease",
    "text": "This is a batch program that will run periodically on new Consultation Requests to predict diseases based on machine learning Algorithm and prioritize the Requests (Critical/ Medium/ Low)",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-8",
    "section": "8",
    "section_title": "Provide Consultation",
    "text": "Doctors shall see the prioritized consultation requests and provide diagnosis, prescribe medicines and suggest lab requests, if any",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-9",
    "section": "9",
    "section_title": "Deliver Medicines",
    "text": "Chemist shall be able to view the open prescriptions assigned to them (based on Pincode) and have the facility to update the status",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-9",
    "section": "9",
    "section_title": "Deliver Medicines",
    "text": "Medicines shall be delivered offline to Patient by Chemist",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-10",
    "section": "10",
    "section_title": "Perform Lab Tests",
    "text": "Lab In-charge shall be able to view open lab-requests and have the facility to update the status",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-10",
    "section": "10",
    "section_title": "Perform Lab Tests",
    "text": "Actual Sample Collection and lab tests shall be offline",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-10",
    "section": "10",
    "section_title": "Perform Lab Tests",
    "text": "Labs shall also submit reports to Patient offline",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": false,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-11",
    "section": "11",
    "section_title": "View/Generate Prescription/ Print Invoice",
    "text": "Patient shall have the facility to view the Prescription and print the invoice",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-11",
    "section": "11",
    "section_title": "View/Generate Prescription/ Print Invoice",
    "text": "Admin can print and email the Prescription and Invoice",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-12",
    "section": "12",
    "section_title": "Housekeeping Patient Profiles and Consultation Requests",
    "text": "Quarterly all Patient Profiles which have not raised any Consultation Request for last 3 years will be archived",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-12",
    "section": "12",
    "section_title": "Housekeeping Patient Profiles and Consultation Requests",
    "text": "Every quarter, Consultation Requests that are more than 3 years old shall be archived",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-13",
    "section": "13",
    "section_title": "Daily Back-up",
    "text": "Every night, full back-up of the system (both Database and Code) shall be taken and sent to remote site for safekeeping",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-13",
    "section": "13",
    "section_title": "Daily Back-up",
    "text": "The back-ups shall be rotated every 30 days",
    "kind": "constraint",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "Req-14",
    "section": "14",
    "section_title": "Learning Disease",
    "text": "Every Month Administration will improve the Disease Prediction Database with learning of the prior month, i.e. improve the training data-set by including the actual learning for the month",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
